reason: I only get Saturdays with my kid and the zoo is free, so $14 a visit is hard to justify when I'd be paying for a Saturday that's already covered. I'd maybe use the free first visit, but I can't see myself paying after that.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? The Baby Nook helps, but a 5-year-old is still in the same room on a busy Saturday, and Saturday is the only day I can come.
would_change_my_mind: Quiet, age-separated Saturday sessions for under-2s, or a lower drop-in price around $8 to $9 on weekends.
